#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct ScannerWrapper {
    istream& in;
    ScannerWrapper(istream& input) : in(input) {}
    string nextToken() {
        string token;
        while (!(in >> token)) {
            in.clear();
            in.ignore(numeric_limits<streamsize>::max(), '\n');
        }
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(nextToken());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(nextToken());
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    ostream& out;
    ScannerWrapper& sc;

    Solver(ostream& output, ScannerWrapper& scanner) : out(output), sc(scanner) {}

    void solve(int all, int t) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();

        vector<vector<long long>> dp(n, vector<long long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= i; c++) {
                    if (j - c >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - c];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) dp[i][j] += mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> prefixSum(n, vector<long long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;
                prefixSum[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        vector<long long> fact(251001, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)fact.size(); i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> nCr(501, vector<long long>(501, 0));
        nCr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 500; i++) {
            nCr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - 2; i++) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long long comb = (nCr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;
            long long total = 0;
            vector<long long>& last = dp[cnt - 2];
            long long ssum = 0;
            long long totalSum = 0;
            for (int j = 2; j < (int)dp[0].size(); j++) {
                total += prefixSum[cnt - 2][j - 2] * (cnt - 1);
                total %= mod;
                long long temp = last[j] * total;
                res += temp;
                res %= mod;

                ssum += prefixSum[cnt - 2][j - 2];
                if (j - cnt - 1 >= 0) ssum -= prefixSum[cnt - 2][j - cnt - 1];
                ssum = (ssum + mod) % mod;

                total -= ssum;
                total = (total + mod) % mod;
            }
            res += (prefixSum[cnt - 2][0] * comb) % mod;
            res %= mod;
        }
        out << res << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    ScannerWrapper sc(cin);
    Solver solver(cout, sc);
    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        solver.solve(T, t);
    }
    return 0;
}
